# Encapsulate

> We run validators on public blockchains, from testnet to mainnet. Stake with us, or book a call if your network is launching.

We keep blockchains online.
Validator infrastructure for new chains, from the first testnet through mainnet.

## Company

- [Encapsulate - Validators for networks we believe in](https://encapsulate.xyz/): We run validators on public blockchains, from testnet to mainnet. Stake with us, or book a call if your network is launching.
- [Services and tooling](https://encapsulate.xyz/services): Dashboards, Ansible playbooks, governance bots and monitoring we build for the chains we run. Open and free to use.
- [Security](https://encapsulate.xyz/security): How we hold keys, run machines and handle upgrades: the rules we hold ourselves to.
- [Governance](https://encapsulate.xyz/governance): How we decide every on-chain vote, and the public record of each one we have cast.
- [Governance Record](https://encapsulate.xyz/governance/votes)
- [Investments](https://encapsulate.xyz/investments): The networks and teams we have backed, usually before mainnet, usually as an operator first.
- [Contact](https://encapsulate.xyz/contact): Book a call, or write to hello@encapsulate.xyz. A person replies.

## Networks

- [Networks](https://encapsulate.xyz/networks): Every chain we validate, mainnet and testnet, with the reward rate where the chain publishes one.
- [Agoric staking](https://encapsulate.xyz/networks/agoric): Stake BLD with Encapsulate on Agoric: 10% commission, 6.4% a year after commission, 21 days unbonding. Non-custodial.

## Blog

- [Blog](https://encapsulate.xyz/blog): Explainers, field notes and new-network posts from running validators.
- [Agoric Testnet Technical Analysis](https://encapsulate.xyz/blog/agoric-testnet-17-analysis): Validators were missing blocks in phase 4.5. We pulled the data and found the culprit.
- [Aleo Node Setup With Monitoring](https://encapsulate.xyz/blog/aleo-node-setup): Run an Aleo node as prover, client or validator — hardware, ports, and monitoring that works.
- [Aleo Record Model](https://encapsulate.xyz/blog/aleo-record-model): Accounts waste work and leak state. Aleo's record model, and what it buys you.
- [Arc Network: Where Finance Becomes Software](https://encapsulate.xyz/blog/arc-network): Circle is turning settlement into software. What Arc actually does, and why it matters.
- [Aztec: The Private World Computer Built on Ethereum](https://encapsulate.xyz/blog/aztec): Privacy you can program, on Ethereum. What Noir and a three-layer network make possible.
- [Berachain's Proof-of-Liquidity, Explained](https://encapsulate.xyz/blog/berachain-research): Proof-of-Liquidity pays the pools that keep markets deep. How Berachain's economics work.
- [Can Quantum Computing Crack Bitcoin?](https://encapsulate.xyz/blog/can-quantum-computing-crack-bitcoin): Bitcoin's keys are not broken yet. Here is the research, the timeline and the honest risk.
- [Canton Network: Privacy Meets Tokenization](https://encapsulate.xyz/blog/canton-network): Institutions want privacy and tokenisation at once. Canton's answer, and what we run on it.
- [Celestia Testnet Log Analysis](https://encapsulate.xyz/blog/celestia-testnet-log-analysis): What a testnet's logs say about its health. Our analysis, with the code to repeat it.
- [Delegating zk-SNARKs Proofs with Privacy for Performance](https://encapsulate.xyz/blog/prover-delegation): Proving is expensive. Delegating it without giving away the secret, and what that costs.
- [Double Zero](https://encapsulate.xyz/blog/doublezero): The public internet is Solana's bottleneck. What IBRL means, and how DoubleZero routes past it.
- [Espresso : Fast Finality Meets Interoperability](https://encapsulate.xyz/blog/espresso): Fast finality and shared settlement, so chains stop being islands. We run a node on it.
- [FogoChain: I Feel the Need, The Need for Speed](https://encapsulate.xyz/blog/fogochain): One client, Firedancer, tuned for trading-floor latency. Fogo's bet, examined.
- [Genlayer Bradbury Testnet: Where AI Learns to Agree](https://encapsulate.xyz/blog/genlayer-bradbury): AI agents need contracts that can judge, not just execute. Inside the Bradbury testnet.
- [GenLayer: The Court of the Internet for the AI Age](https://encapsulate.xyz/blog/genlayer): Contracts that can weigh a subjective claim. GenLayer as the internet's small-claims court.
- [Gno.land: Where Communities Control Their Apps](https://encapsulate.xyz/blog/gnoland-where-communities-control-their-apps): A validator seat earned by contributing code, not by buying stake. We joined at testnet.
- [Governance Bot Improvements](https://encapsulate.xyz/blog/governance-bot-improvements): Our bot posts chain proposals to Discord as they land. What we fixed: auto-publish and spam.
- [How Aleo executes Decentralized Private Computation](https://encapsulate.xyz/blog/aleo-dpc): Zero-knowledge proofs beyond fixed circuits. How Aleo runs private computation.
- [How decentralized is Aptos Really ?](https://encapsulate.xyz/blog/is-aptos-decentralized): We mapped every Aptos validator by ISP and country. The answer is uncomfortable.
- [IOTA Rebased: Unlocking New Possibilities](https://encapsulate.xyz/blog/iota-rebased-unlocking-new-possibilities): IOTA moves from UTXO to objects and adds staking. What Rebased changes for validators.
- [Is Wrapped Bitcoin the Next Terra Luna?](https://encapsulate.xyz/blog/possible-wbtc-crash): Every wrapped BTC is someone's promise. We look at who holds the keys, and what breaks.
- [MegaETH: Web3 at Web2 Speed](https://encapsulate.xyz/blog/megaeth-web3-at-web2-speed): Web2 speed on Ethereum's security, through mini-blocks and a realtime API. How it holds up.
- [Monad: L1 Scaling Fixed Forever?](https://encapsulate.xyz/blog/monad-l1-scaling): MonadBFT, RaptorCast and parallel execution: the ideas behind Monad's throughput.
- [Monad: Speed Without Sacrifice](https://encapsulate.xyz/blog/monad-speed-without-sacrifice): Parallel execution without leaving the EVM. What Monad changes for builders and for nodes.
- [NEAR Protocol 2025 Outlook: What’s Ahead?](https://encapsulate.xyz/blog/near-protocol-2025-outlook): Chain abstraction, intents and user-owned AI. Where NEAR is actually heading in 2025.
- [Pharos Network: Unlocking the RealFi Era](https://encapsulate.xyz/blog/pharos): Real-world assets need rails that scale and comply. Pharos is building them; we validate.
- [Solana in 2025: Transforming Into A Behemoth](https://encapsulate.xyz/blog/solana-state-2025): Firedancer, institutional flows and record throughput. Solana's 2025, read by operators.
- [Somnia Network: The Future of On-Chain Everything](https://encapsulate.xyz/blog/somnia): A million transactions a second — and what has to be true for that number to matter.
- [Story Protocol: Streamlining IP Rights for Creators.](https://encapsulate.xyz/blog/story-protocol): IP as code: licensing, royalties and provenance on-chain. What Story gives creators.
- [Symbiotic Finance: A Deep Dive](https://encapsulate.xyz/blog/symbiotic): Shared security without giving up control. How Symbiotic pools stake across protocols.
- [The Rise Of Intent-Centric Blockchains](https://encapsulate.xyz/blog/intent-centric-blockchains): Stop writing transactions; state the outcome. Anoma, SUAVE and Essential, compared.
- [The Rise of Move: Rebuilding Blockchain Logic](https://encapsulate.xyz/blog/move-chains): One language, three chains, very different bets. Sui, IOTA and Aptos on Move, explained.
- [What are Zk Snarks ?](https://encapsulate.xyz/blog/zk-snarks): Zero-knowledge proofs first, then zk-SNARKs — explained without the maths degree.
- [What Broke Coldcard's Bitcoin Security?](https://encapsulate.xyz/blog/what-broke-coldcards-bitcoin-security): A firmware bug cut seed entropy and $89m walked out. What it should teach the rest of us.
- [Who Builds the Stablecoin Rails?](https://encapsulate.xyz/blog/who-builds-the-stablecoin-rails): Crypto proved it can move value. Moving money is a different job — here is who is building it.
- [XMTP: The Future of Messaging?](https://encapsulate.xyz/blog/xmtp-the-future-of-messaging): Encrypted messaging that no platform owns. What XMTP is, and why wallets are adopting it.
- [ZEXE: How Aleo Achives private computation ?](https://encapsulate.xyz/blog/zexe): ZEXE is how Aleo gets private, expressive computation. Commitments and proofs, unpacked.
- [Zilliqa 2.0 Launch - What major changes we can expect?](https://encapsulate.xyz/blog/zilliqa-2-launch): X-shards, proof of stake and smart accounts. What Zilliqa 2.0 changes from a validator's seat.
